# The Bet · FinWise

> Module 1 · Ignite a PLG Motion. The growth hypothesis and where you're betting, plus the growth-loop visualization.

## Growth hypothesis

FinWise's biggest growth problem is 1.99% Trial to Paid conversion, because the aha moment is not visible to most of the users..

_Working notes: I think Finwise's biggest problem is the trial to paid user conversion. Evidence: Only 2% of customers who begin a trial convert to paying customers
Adding more money to acquisition is no longer driving meaningful growth Against the data: 1.99% Trial to Paid conversion is very low._

_____

## The bet

Onboarding funnel to guide users towards the aha moment of the product.

**Not doing:** I am not going after referral loops as the min drop off does not lie there.

_____

## Growth loop

**Loop type:** Collaboration, I would try to make my tool a dependency for the users so that they get more engaged with the product.
